description: This file defines an abstract class 'ReportDataAPI' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Api\Rest'. The class provides REST API endpoints for retrieving report data, including the 'getAll' method that fetches report data with validation and filtering. It sets up the structure for report data retrieval in the HRM system, implementing collection endpoints and including validation rules, while leaving create and delete operations unimplemented.

classes.name: ReportDataAPI
classes.description: An abstract class providing REST API endpoints for retrieving report data within the OrangeHRM system. Implements validation, filtering, and data fetching logic for report endpoints, serving as a base for specific report APIs.
